newsitem.title: USA: Wilmar to buy Aaron Distrubtion.
newsitem.headline: Wilmar to buy Aaron Distrubtion.

text.p: Wilmar Industries Inc said on Monday it has agreed to buy the assets of Aaron Distribution Inc for a combination of cash and stock.
Aaron Distribution, which had 1995 revenues of $5.5 million, is a supplier of repair and maintenance products to multi-unit apartment complexes in the Dallas-Ft. Worth market.
The transaction is scheduled to close in November.
Wilmar Industries is a national marketer and direct distributor of repair and maintenance products, with 15 distribution centers throughout the United States.
Terms of the deal were not immediately available.
